note: Nulab's ground (settlements/nulab/targets/town/90n-nl-world.js samples their maps in world metres, blended by a zone mask painted from the town's records; no kit piece draws them). The buildings are the Dalab set's, on the Xanadu pack's shared keys and the trimmed Dalab pack. Reused sets, none new: nlGrass (ground.grass_ground, the basin's Csa grass, as Thalaba's tGrass), nlDirt (ground.dirt, the wards' yards and made ground), nlEarth (earth.floor.packed, the beaten-earth streets of a Dalab town), nlFlag (paving.flagstone, the mound's plaza, the quays and the market), nlSand (ground.damp_beach_sand, the bay's shore and the river's banks), nlTilled (ground.tilled, the fields); keep 1: the sets' own colours.
